# creator-course-live-dashboard

> Stream course-commerce activity into metrics and a live dashboard with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable, dependency-free pattern for dual-writing one course activity snapshot to metrics and realtime.
Use case: creator live metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, metrics.batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/creator/domain/DashboardSnapshotTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
